summary: Update the "Crystal" app to use a black + blue liquid-glass visual theme, rename the home screen tile from "Gen 4 Elc" to "Gen 4", add model descriptions/ranges to the Gen 4 options (Base 0-90, Pro 0-120, Racer 0-360), implement a mock checkout + order confirmation flow when clicking "Buy", and add a new "Gen 5" item on the home menu with a Gen 5 options page mirroring Gen 4 structure (Base/Pro/Racer) with new MPH descriptions. Update Gen 5 so ALL three options use a "Pre Order" label/action, update Mgp ID handling so it must match the pattern "mgp-" + digits only (any numeric sequence), and change the Mgp ID submit/confirm flow so that after entering an Mgp ID it navigates to the checkout flow. Add/attach pricing to options: Gen 4 = $500, Gen 4 Pro = $1000, Gen 4 Racer = $2000; Gen 5 = $1000, Gen 5 Pro = $2500, Gen 5 Racer = $5000. Keep diamond character icons (♦) for Gen 4/Gen 5 items/options and adjust their styling to gray + purple.
architectural_notes: Mgp ID input should validate against a simple pattern: /^mgp-\d+$/ (case-sensitive unless otherwise specified).
After successful Mgp ID submission, route user into the existing checkout flow (carry selected model context as needed).

existing_features.title: Create a home screen that displays a top header reading "Crystal" and, below it, shows two selectable tiles/cards (placeholders for two items). One tile must be labeled "Gen 4 Elc" and show the subtitle "Click to see options".
Implement navigation so that selecting/clicking the "Gen 4 Elc" tile on the home screen routes the user to a dedicated "Gen 4 Elc" options page.

On the "Gen 4 Elc" options page, display three options in a clear list/grid: (1) "Gen 4", (2) "Gen 4 Pro", (3) "Gen 4 Racer". Under options 1 and 2, render a "Buy" action. Under option 3, render a "Show valid Mgp Id" action.

Define basic behavior for the three actions: clicking "Buy" (for "Gen 4" and "Gen 4 Pro") must show an in-app confirmation/feedback state (e.g., modal, toast, or inline message) indicating the item was selected for purchase (no real payment). Clicking "Show valid Mgp Id" must display a small in-app panel/modal that shows a set of example valid Mgp IDs and provides an input field to check whether an entered ID is valid against that example list.
Apply a consistent, creative visual theme across the app (colors, typography, spacing, component styling) suitable for a product/options selection interface, avoiding a blue+purple primary palette.

Update the Home screen primary tile label text from "Gen 4 Elc" to "Gen 4" while keeping the existing subtitle "Click to see options" and keeping the existing navigation target/behavior (click still routes to the existing Gen 4 options page route).
Update the Gen 4 options page model descriptions to exactly match the following user-provided text: Gen 4 = "Base model 0-90"; Gen 4 Pro = "Pro model 0-120"; Gen 4 Racer = "Racer model 0-360".

Keep Mgp ID verification required for the Gen 4 Racer flow: Gen 4 Racer must continue to use the "Show valid Mgp Id" action that opens the Mgp ID dialog with the input and validation feedback (valid/invalid), and it must not add a "Buy" action for Gen 4 Racer.

Replace the current warm palette styling with a cohesive black + blue "liquid glass" theme across the app (Home, options page, and dialog), including: dark/near-black backgrounds, blue highlights/accents, glassmorphism surfaces (semi-transparent cards with subtle borders, backdrop blur where supported), and consistent typography/spacing. Update the Tailwind/CSS theme tokens so that components using design tokens (bg-background, bg-card, border-border, text-foreground, primary/accent) automatically match the new theme.

Update the Gen 4 options page so that clicking the "Buy" button for "Gen 4" or "Gen 4 Pro" navigates to a new mock checkout page (instead of only showing a toast), carrying along which model the user selected.

Create a new mock checkout page that displays form fields for address and payment details (at minimum: Address, Credit card number, ZIP code) and a primary button labeled "Done". The user must not be required to enter valid values; the "Done" button must be usable even with empty fields.

After the user clicks "Done" on the mock checkout page, navigate to a new order confirmation page that shows "Order placed" and displays an arrival date randomly chosen between 2/25/26 and 5/25/26 (inclusive). The arrival date should be generated once per order submission and remain stable while viewing that confirmation screen.
Add the necessary TanStack Router routes for the new checkout page and order confirmation page, ensuring existing routes ('/' and '/gen4-elc') continue to work as-is.
Update the Home page to add a new selectable tile labeled "Gen 5" (in addition to the existing "Gen 4" tile) that routes the user to a new Gen 5 options page.
Add a new TanStack Router route for the Gen 5 options page and wire it into the app router without changing existing routes.

Create a new Gen 5 options page that mirrors the Gen 4 options page layout (3 options in a clear grid/list), with the following exact user-facing option titles and descriptions: (1) "Gen 5" with description "Base Model 0-120 Mph"; (2) "Gen 5 Pro" with description "0-200 Mph"; (3) "Gen 5 Racer" with description "0-300 Mph" and it must communicate that an Mgp ID is required.

Implement Gen 5 option actions to match Gen 4 behavior for purchase flow: "Gen 5" and "Gen 5 Pro" must have a "Buy" action that navigates to the existing mock checkout page and passes the selected model via router search params; "Gen 5 Racer" must not have a "Buy" action and instead must have a primary action labeled "Pre Order" that requires Mgp ID entry/validation before showing a success/confirmation state.

Add a diamond icon for all Gen 4 and Gen 5 items/options: update the Home tiles and both options pages (Gen 4 options and new Gen 5 options) to display a diamond icon in each tile/card or option card, using a shared generated static image asset.

Replace the current diamond icon image used on the Home page, Gen 4 options page, and Gen 5 options page with the diamond character "♦" (no image), keeping sizing/alignment visually consistent with the existing layout.
Update the Gen 4 options page descriptions to keep the existing wording but append " Mph" to each description.

Update the Gen 5 options page so that all three Gen 5 models (Gen 5, Gen 5 Pro, Gen 5 Racer) display a primary action labeled "Pre Order" (replace any "Buy" label for Gen 5 and Gen 5 Pro). Keep the existing click behaviors (Gen 5 / Gen 5 Pro continue to navigate to the existing /checkout flow; Gen 5 Racer continues to open the pre-order dialog).

Change Mgp ID handling to accept whatever the user types (no validation against a predefined list) anywhere an Mgp ID is entered in the UI (including Gen 4 Racer and Gen 5 Racer dialogs). Remove example valid ID lists and remove any "Invalid" state; submitting/confirming should always succeed and show a success/accepted state using the entered value.

Add and display pricing for each model on the Gen 4 options page and the Gen 5 options page, using the following exact prices: Gen 4 = $500; Gen 4 Pro = $1000; Gen 4 Racer = $2000; Gen 5 = $1000; Gen 5 Pro = $2500; Gen 5 Racer = $5000. Prices must be visible on each option card in a clear, consistent location.

Update the app’s visual theme to a cohesive gray + purple palette (replacing the current black/blue liquid-glass palette) by adjusting the Tailwind/CSS design tokens so that surfaces, borders, text, and primary/accent colors render as gray-forward with purple highlights across Home, options pages, dialogs, checkout, and order confirmation.

Enforce MGP ID format validation everywhere the user enters an MGP ID (Gen 4 Racer dialog and Gen 5 Racer dialog): the value must start with the literal prefix "mgp-" and be followed by digits only (any length, any numeric sequence).

Change the MGP ID confirm flow so that after the user enters a valid MGP ID and confirms, the app navigates directly to the existing checkout page (/checkout) instead of showing a success/accepted panel; pass the selected model in router search params so the checkout header shows the correct model.

new_feature_requests.summary: Create "Crystal" home screen with title at top and a Gen 4 Elc card showing "click to see options" that navigates to the Gen 4 options page.
Implement Gen 4 options page listing: Gen 4, Gen 4 Pro (each with a "Buy" action) and Gen 4 Racer (with a "Show valid Mgp Id" action/requirement).
Apply a black + blue "liquid glass" visual theme across the app (including the home screen), replacing the prior non-blue palette constraint.
Rename the home screen tile label from "Gen 4 Elc" to "Gen 4" (keep navigation behavior to the options page).
Add/update Gen 4 options descriptions: Gen 4 = "Base model 0-90", Gen 4 Pro = "Pro model 0-120", Gen 4 Racer = "Racer model 0-360"; keep Mgp ID verification required for Racer.

When clicking "Buy" (Gen 4 / Gen 4 Pro), navigate to a mock checkout page collecting address + credit card fields (no required validation/entry) with a "Done" button, then show an "Order placed" screen with a randomly generated arrival date between 2/25/26 and 5/25/26.
Add a new "Gen 5" tile/item on the home screen menu that navigates to a dedicated Gen 5 options page (parallel to Gen 4).

Create a Gen 5 options page with three options mirroring Gen 4: (1) Gen 5 = "Base Model 0-120 Mph", (2) Gen 5 Pro = "0-200 Mph", (3) Gen 5 Racer = "0-300 Mph"; Gen 5 Racer must require Mgp ID and show a "Pre Order" action/label instead of "Buy".
Add diamond icons for all relevant items/options (Gen 4 and Gen 5).
Change the diamond icons currently used for Gen 4/Gen 5 to use the ♦ diamond character instead of the existing diamond image asset.
Update Gen 4 option descriptions to keep the same text but append "Mph" to each (Gen 4, Gen 4 Pro, Gen 4 Racer).
Update Gen 5 options so all three (Gen 5 / Gen 5 Pro / Gen 5 Racer) display and use a "Pre Order" label/action (not just Racer).
Add pricing for each model on the options pages: Gen 4 $500, Gen 4 Pro $1000, Gen 4 Racer $2000; Gen 5 $1000, Gen 5 Pro $2500, Gen 5 Racer $5000 (display prices alongside each option).
Update ♦ icon styling to be gray and purple (adjust the icon color/style across the app where ♦ is used).

Change Mgp ID flow so that after the user enters/submits an Mgp ID (e.g., in the Gen 4 Racer / Gen 5 Racer dialogs), the app navigates to the checkout flow instead of only showing an accepted/success state.
Add Mgp ID format validation: entered ID must start with "mgp-" and be followed by digits only (any numeric sequence).
